title: PPA: https://launchpad.net/~slyon/+archive/ubuntu/lp2131236-amd64v3-vdso/+packages
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 74f215b..3962dfc 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+qemu (1:10.1.0+ds-5ubuntu2.2) questing; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Use upstream vDSO for architecture variant builds (LP: #2131236)
+
+ -- Lukas Märdian <slyon@ubuntu.com>  Wed, 03 Dec 2025 10:46:40 +0100
+
 qemu (1:10.1.0+ds-5ubuntu2.1) questing; urgency=medium
 
   * d/p/u/lp-2123828-*: Fix RISC-V instructions endianness (LP: #2123828)
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index fef1be6..9481216 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -31,7 +31,11 @@ ifeq ($(VENDOR),ubuntu)
   # upstream tests either.
   export DEB_BUILD_PROFILES += nocheck
 
-  ifneq ($(DEB_HOST_ARCH),amd64)
+  # Enable upstream vDSO if the OR expands to a non-empty string, e.g.:
+  # - $DEB_HOST_ARCH != amd64, OR
+  # - $DEB_HOST_ARCH_VARIANT is set (non-emtpy, e.g. amd64v3)
+  # Those are the conditions where we only run the "binary-arch" build.
+  ifneq ($(or $(filter-out amd64,$(DEB_HOST_ARCH)),$(DEB_HOST_ARCH_VARIANT)),)
     export DEB_BUILD_PROFILES += pkg.qemu.use-upstream-vdso
   endif
 endif
